steps.instruction: Remove the seeds and strings from the squash halves.
Cut a small piece off the outside of each half so it stands level.
Place the halves in a shallow pan with 1/4 inch of water, insides facing down.
Mix 1 tablespoon of marmalade and 1 teaspoon of butter or margarine in a small bowl.
Take the squash out of the oven and turn the halves over in the pan.
Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon of salt lightly over the squash.
Spread the marmalade mixture on the edges, letting the extra run into the center.
Put the squash under the broiler for 5 minutes, until lightly browned.
